name: Delete with smoky dissolve Pro
one_line: Delete with smoky dissolve is part of Transitions Pro. Image shreds and falls into smoke. The full source ships as CSS, React and TypeScript variants, in the Pro skill and through the npm package. See what Pro includes .
licence: MIT, collection may not be republished
withheld_reason: their terms allow use but forbid republishing the collection

verdict.reason: Pro; a dissolve would hide what was deleted, which is the opposite of what a delete confirmation needs.
